// Existing hand-written batch approval: status, per-target audit and the
// completed idempotent result commit in one transaction.
package candidate

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/XUJiahua/enterprise_agent/internal/app"
	"github.com/XUJiahua/enterprise_agent/internal/protocol"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

const opApprove = "bulk-approve.v3"

// Same digest as ledger.Fingerprint(opApprove, ids); reconciliation recomputes it.
func fingerprint(ids []string) string {
	h := sha256.New()
	fmt.Fprint(h, opApprove, "\n")
	for _, id := range ids {
		fmt.Fprintf(h, "%d:%s", len(id), id)
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))
}

func New(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, fallback http.Handler) (http.Handler, error) {
	approve := func(ctx context.Context, u app.Identity, key string, ids []string) (protocol.Result, bool, error) {
		for _, id := range ids {
			if strings.ContainsRune(id, 0) {
				return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 404}
			}
		}
		tx, err := pool.Begin(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		defer tx.Rollback(ctx)
		_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT set_config('app.tenant',$1,true),set_config('app.user',$2,true),set_config('app.role',$3,true)`, u.Tenant, u.User, u.Role)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		lock, _ := json.Marshal([]string{opApprove, u.Tenant, u.User, key})
		if _, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0))`, string(lock)); err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}

	}

	if len(key) < 1 || len(key) > 128 {

	for _, c := range key {

		}
	}
	return true

const opApprove = "bulk-approve.v3"
const opReject = "bulk-reject.v4"

// Same digest as ledger.Fingerprint(op, ids); reconciliation recomputes it.
func fingerprint(op string, ids []string) string {
	h := sha256.New()
	fmt.Fprint(h, op, "\n")
	for _, id := range ids {
		fmt.Fprintf(h, "%d:%s", len(id), id)
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))

		tag, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE "Purchase" SET status='rejected' WHERE id=ANY($1::text[]) AND "tenantId"=$2 AND "createdBy"<>$3 AND status='submitted'`, ids, u.Tenant, u.User)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		if tag.RowsAffected() != int64(len(ids)) {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: 409}
		}
		// Every status transition leaves one ApprovalAudit row per target.
		_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO "ApprovalAudit" ("tenantId","purchaseId","approvedBy",operation,"idempotencyKey","fromStatus","toStatus")
		 SELECT $2,id,$3,$4,$5,'submitted','rejected' FROM unnest($1::text[]) AS id`, ids, u.Tenant, u.User, opReject, key)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		result := protocol.Result{Field: "rejectedIds", IDs: ids}
		response, err := json.Marshal(result)
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO "ActionRequest" ("tenantId","actorId",operation,key,"requestHash",response)
		 VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6::jsonb)`, u.Tenant, u.User, opReject, key, hash, string(response))
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		if err = tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		return result, false, nil
	}

	return protocol.HTTP(protocol.Routes{
		"/purchases/bulk-approve": approve,
		"/purchases/bulk-reject":  reject,
	}, fallback), nil
}
